purpose: Joint descriptive context of all three same-center records, all seven existing epochs and all three unique fixed discovery references. No new detection search or origin classifier. Core flux was already visible in completed C003.

fixed_geometry.core_basis: Union of the three identical original ±0.25 Å cores, not a fitted linewidth.
fixed_geometry.grid: 601 centers from −3 to +3 Å in 0.01 Å steps; 51 core and 550 surrounding centers.
fixed_geometry.anchor_change_from_prior_phases: The first C004 discovery is March 2022, not the January 2022 exposure used as anchor in several earlier phases. All frames use this single C004 anchor.

coverage_interpretation: Fresh all-216-order scan identifies only order 3 covering each original feature center. Both fixed frame windows lie within each selected order endpoint range. This is coordinate support, not a guarantee of finite flux, positive references, normalization or physical origin.
reference_dependence: All three discovery products are distinct and remain fixed references. Shared original epochs, reversed pairs, repeated windows and same-exposure native/merged extraction agreement do not add independent observations or detections.

prior_window_dependence.interpretation: The C004 core was already visible in C003 positive reference flank. Reciprocally the complete original C003 core union lies within C004 negative reference flank. Both references contain known structure; retain it without masking and do not claim blind or independent wavelength evidence.

frame_caveat: The one first-discovery topocentric anchor is fixed. Expected barycentrically coherent feature locations can lie outside the fixed ±0.25 Å core; those correlations concern the anchor window and potentially neighboring structure, not a recentered feature. In January 2022 the predicted center is only slightly beyond the fixed edge, which is retained without moving the gate.
normalization: Signed native-sample pooled median over 1.5≤|offset|≤3 Å, with at least 20 finite samples separately in each flank and a positive pooled reference. Invalid/missing/low-reference outcomes stay explicit; no clipping, sign flip, moved windows, extrapolation or fitted baseline. Structured flanks are reference levels, not proven line-free continua.
statistics: Unshifted raw Pearson and normalized RMS with fixed coverage gates; positive scalar normalization leaves Pearson invariant. No origin threshold, free lag, linewidth, RV, significance calibration or sensitivity estimate. Missing ERR and descriptive first differences are not a formal uncertainty model.
raw_and_native_limits: All three historical global, local, baseline and later five-window mapping diagnostics are true, independently matched to the original table. This preserves existing supported registration but is not a new mapping validation, line identity or origin classification. Do not import the C007 local-failure caveat into C004.
Preserve every historical raw/excess panel and inherited background subtraction. No new raw registration, background fitting, classifier or pixel statistics.
Native BUNIT absent; native values remain unspecified extracted units. Merged ADU are uncalibrated. Same-exposure native/merged agreement is not an independent confirmation or physical flux ratio.
Catalog fixed-template widths are not measured physical linewidths. All three U labels remain unchanged; morphology alone establishes neither a qualified laser candidate nor calibrated null.
next_group_fixed_before_results: NEXT_GROUP_METADATA.json fixes singleton C002 / V2E2-0033 at original queue row 10 and 3868.6025 Å. Its core was already visible in C003 surrounding-spectrum window; retain that earlier dependence although it is outside C004 current window.
